require_relative 'terms'

module Prolog
  Clause = Struct.new(:head, :body, :file, :line, keyword_init: true)
  class Database
    attr_reader :predicates
    def initialize = @predicates = {}
    def add(key, clause) = (predicates[key] ||= []) << clause
    def candidates(goal)
      key = Terms.indicator(goal)
      clauses = predicates.fetch(key)
      return clauses if key[1].zero?
      x = Terms.deref(goal.args[0])
      clauses.select do |clause|
        y = Terms.deref(clause.head.args[0])
        if x.is_a?(Variable) || y.is_a?(Variable)
          true
        elsif x.is_a?(Compound) && y.is_a?(Compound)
          x.name == y.name && x.args.length == y.args.length
        else
          x.class == y.class && x == y
        end
      end
    end
    def copy_clause(clause)
      map = {}
      [Terms.copy(clause.head, map), clause.body && Terms.copy(clause.body, map)]
    end
  end
end

require 'set'
require_relative 'reader'
require_relative 'database'
require_relative 'predicates'

module Prolog
  Entry = Struct.new(:goal, :barrier, :context)
  Marker = Struct.new(:kind, :value)
  ChoicePoint = Struct.new(:kind, :trail, :resume, :data)
  class InferenceLimit < StandardError; end
  class RaisedBall < StandardError
    attr_reader :ball
    def initialize(ball)
      @ball = Terms.copy(ball)
      super('Prolog exception')
    end
  end
  class Interpreter
    CONTROLS = [[',', 2], ['!', 0], [';', 2], ['->', 2], ['\\+', 1], ['catch', 3]] + (1..8).map { |n| ['call', n] }
    def initialize
      @database = Database.new
      @reports = []
      @file_counts = Hash.new { |h, k| h[k] = { clauses: 0, errors: 0, warnings: 0 } }
      @calls, @tries = Hash.new(0), Hash.new(0)
    end
    def reserved?(key) = CONTROLS.include?(key) || Predicates::SIGNATURES.include?(key)
    def shape?(term, name, arity) = term.is_a?(Compound) && term.name == name && term.args.length == arity
    def convert(term)
      term = Terms.deref(term)
      return Terms.compound('call', term) if term.is_a?(Variable)
      return nil if term.is_a?(Integer)
      if term.is_a?(Compound) && %w[, ; ->].include?(term.name) && term.args.length == 2
        left, right = term.args.map { |a| convert(a) }
        return nil unless left && right
        Terms.compound(term.name, left, right)
      else
        term
      end
    end
    def atom_name(name, quoted)
      return name unless quoted
      simple = name.match?(/\A[a-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*\z/) || !name.empty? && name != '.' && name.chars.all? { |c| SYMBOLS.include?(c) } || %w[[] ! ;].include?(name)
      return name if simple
      escaped = name.each_char.map { |c| { '\\' => '\\\\', "'" => "\\'", "\n" => '\\n', "\t" => '\\t' }.fetch(c, c) }.join
      "'#{escaped}'"
    end
    def writer_names(seed = {})
      count = 0
      lambda { |variable| seed[variable] ||= "_G#{count += 1}" }
    end
    def write_term(term, quoted = true, limit = 1200, operand = false, names = nil)
      names ||= writer_names
      term = Terms.deref(term)
      case term
      when Variable then names.call(term)
      when Integer then term.to_s
      when String
        result = atom_name(term, quoted)
        operand && (INFIX.key?(term) || PREFIX.key?(term)) ? "(#{result})" : result
      when Compound
        name, args = term.name, term.args
        if name == '.' && args.length == 2
          elements, tail = Terms.elements(term)
          text = elements.map { |a| write_term(a, quoted, 999, false, names) }.join(',')
          text += "|#{write_term(tail, quoted, 999, false, names)}" unless tail == '[]'
          "[#{text}]"
        elsif args.length == 2 && INFIX.key?(name)
          p, type = INFIX[name]
          l = write_term(args[0], quoted, type == :yfx ? p : p - 1, true, names)
          r = write_term(args[1], quoted, type == :xfy ? p : p - 1, true, names)
          if name == ','
            text = "#{l},#{r}"
          elsif name.match?(/\A[a-z]/)
            text = "#{l} #{name} #{r}"
          else
            before = !l.empty? && SYMBOLS.include?(l[-1]) ? ' ' : ''
            after = !r.empty? && SYMBOLS.include?(r[0]) ? ' ' : ''
            text = "#{l}#{before}#{name}#{after}#{r}"
          end
          p > limit ? "(#{text})" : text
        elsif args.length == 1 && PREFIX.key?(name)
          p = PREFIX[name]
          x = write_term(args[0], quoted, p, true, names)
          space = !x.empty? && (SYMBOLS.include?(x[0]) || x[0].match?(/[0-9(]/)) ? ' ' : ''
          text = "#{name}#{space}#{x}"
          p > limit ? "(#{text})" : text
        else
          "#{atom_name(name, quoted)}(#{args.map { |a| write_term(a, quoted, 999, false, names) }.join(',')})"
        end
      end
    end
    def indicator_text(key) = write_term(Terms.pi(*key))
    def report(file, line, kind, message)
      @reports << "#{file}:#{line}: #{kind}: #{message}"
      @file_counts[file][kind == 'error' ? :errors : :warnings] += 1
    end
    def consult(file)
      text = File.read("input/#{file}")
      lines, reader, last, warned = text.lines(chomp: true), Reader.new(text), nil, Set.new
      until reader.peek.kind == :eof
        line = reader.peek.line
        begin
          term = reader.clause
        rescue ReadError => e
          token = e.token
          @reports << "#{file}:#{token.line}:#{token.column}: syntax error: #{e.message}"
          unless token.kind == :eof
            @reports << "    #{lines.fetch(token.line - 1)}"
            @reports << "#{' ' * (token.column + 3)}^"
          end
          @file_counts[file][:errors] += 1
          reader.recover(e)
          next
        end
        head, body = shape?(term, ':-', 2) ? term.args : [term, nil]
        error = if head.is_a?(Variable)
                  'instantiation_error'
                elsif head.is_a?(Integer)
                  Terms.error('type_error', 'callable', head)
                elsif reserved?(Terms.indicator(head))
                  Terms.error('permission_error', 'modify', 'static_procedure', Terms.pi(*Terms.indicator(head)))
                elsif body && !convert(body)
                  Terms.error('type_error', 'callable', body)
                end
        if error
          report(file, line, 'error', write_term(error))
          next
        end
        body = convert(body) if body
        key = Terms.indicator(head)
        previous = @database.predicates[key]
        if file == 'program.pl' && previous && previous.any? { |c| c.file == 'prelude.pl' }
          report(file, line, 'warning', "redefining prelude procedure #{indicator_text(key)}")
          previous.clear
        end
        if previous && previous.any? { |c| c.file == file } && last != key && !warned.include?(key)
          report(file, line, 'warning', "clauses of #{indicator_text(key)} are not together")
          warned << key
        end
        @database.add(key, Clause.new(head: head, body: body, file: file, line: line))
        @file_counts[file][:clauses] += 1
        last = key
        singles = reader.occurrences.select { |name, count| !name.start_with?('_') && count == 1 }.keys
        repeats = reader.occurrences.select { |name, count| name.start_with?('_') && name.length >= 2 && count >= 2 }.keys
        report(file, line, 'warning', "singleton variables: #{singles.join(', ')}") unless singles.empty?
        report(file, line, 'warning', "variables starting with _ occur more than once: #{repeats.join(', ')}") unless repeats.empty?
      end
    end
    def undefined_warnings
      warned = Set.new
      traverse = lambda do |term, clause, parent|
        return unless Terms.callable?(term)
        key = Terms.indicator(term)
        if %w[, ; ->].include?(key[0]) && key[1] == 2
          term.args.each { |a| traverse.call(a, clause, parent) }
        elsif key == ['\\+', 1] || key == ['call', 1]
          traverse.call(term.args[0], clause, parent)
        elsif key == ['findall', 3]
          traverse.call(term.args[1], clause, parent)
        elsif key == ['catch', 3]
          traverse.call(term.args[0], clause, parent)
          traverse.call(term.args[2], clause, parent)
        elsif !reserved?(key) && !@database.predicates.key?(key) && warned.add?(key)
          report(clause.file, clause.line, 'warning', "undefined procedure #{indicator_text(key)} called from #{indicator_text(parent)}")
        end
      end
      @database.predicates.each { |key, clauses| clauses.each { |c| traverse.call(c.body, c, key) if c.body } }
    end
    def listing
      groups = @database.predicates.values.map do |clauses|
        clauses.flat_map do |clause|
          occurrences = Terms.variables(clause.head)
          Terms.variables(clause.body, occurrences) if clause.body
          counts, seed, index = occurrences.tally, {}, 0
          counts.each do |variable, count|
            if count == 1
              seed[variable] = '_'
            else
              seed[variable] = (65 + index % 26).chr + (index < 26 ? '' : (index / 26).to_s)
              index += 1
            end
          end
          names = ->(v) { seed.fetch(v) }
          head = write_term(clause.head, true, 1200, false, names)
          next ["#{head}."] unless clause.body
          goals, body = [], clause.body
          while shape?(body, ',', 2)
            goals << body.args[0]
            body = body.args[1]
          end
          goals << body
          ["#{head} :-", *goals.each_with_index.map { |g, i| "    #{write_term(g, true, 999, false, names)}#{i == goals.length - 1 ? '.' : ','}" }]
        end.join("\n")
      end
      groups.empty? ? '' : groups.join("\n\n") + "\n"
    end
    def push(goals, tail)
      goals.reverse_each.reduce(tail) { |list, entry| [entry, list] }
    end
    def entry(goal, barrier, context) = Entry.new(goal, barrier, context)
    def point(kind, continuation, data = {})
      cp = ChoicePoint.new(kind, @unifier.trail.length, continuation, data)
      @choices << cp
      @counters[:choicepoints] += 1
      cp
    end
    def cut(height)
      @choices.pop while @choices.length > height
    end
    def inference(key)
      raise InferenceLimit if @counters[:inferences] == 20000
      @counters[:inferences] += 1
      @calls[key] += 1
    end
    def try_clause(clause, goal, barrier, context, continuation)
      @tries[Terms.indicator(goal)] += 1
      head, body = @database.copy_clause(clause)
      return false unless @unifier.unify(head, goal)
      @goals = body ? push([entry(body, barrier, context)], continuation) : continuation
      true
    end
    def user_call(goal, barrier, context, continuation)
      key = Terms.indicator(goal)
      Terms.raise_error('existence_error', 'procedure', Terms.pi(*key)) unless @database.predicates.key?(key)
      candidates = @database.candidates(goal)
      return false if candidates.empty?
      height = @choices.length
      point(:clauses, continuation, goal: goal, candidates: candidates, next: 1, barrier: height, context: context) if candidates.length >= 2
      try_clause(candidates.first, goal, height, context, continuation)
    end
    def between(args, continuation, context)
      low, high = @predicates.integer(args[0]), @predicates.integer(args[1])
      x = Terms.deref(args[2])
      Terms.raise_error('type_error', 'integer', x) unless x.is_a?(Variable) || x.is_a?(Integer)
      return (low..high).cover?(x) if x.is_a?(Integer)
      return false if low > high
      point(:between, continuation, high: high, variable: x, next: low + 1, context: context) if low < high
      @unifier.unify(x, low)
    end
    def length(args, continuation, context)
      n = Terms.deref(args[1])
      Terms.raise_error('type_error', 'integer', n) unless n.is_a?(Variable) || n.is_a?(Integer)
      Terms.raise_error('domain_error', 'not_less_than_zero', n) if n.is_a?(Integer) && n.negative?
      elements, tail = Terms.elements(args[0])
      count = elements.length
      return @unifier.unify(n, count) if tail == '[]'
      Terms.raise_error('type_error', 'list', args[0]) unless tail.is_a?(Variable)
      if n.is_a?(Integer)
        return false if n < count
        @unifier.unify(tail, Terms.list(Array.new(n - count) { Variable.new }))
      else
        point(:length, continuation, tail: tail, variable: n, count: count, next: count + 1, context: context)
        @unifier.unify(tail, '[]') && @unifier.unify(n, count)
      end
    end
    def execute(entry_value, continuation)
      goal, c, k = entry_value.goal, entry_value.barrier, entry_value.context
      @goals = continuation
      if goal.is_a?(Marker)
        case goal.kind
        when :ite then cut(goal.value)
        when :naf then cut(goal.value); return false
        when :exit then @choices.pop if @choices.last.equal?(goal.value)
        when :collect then goal.value.data[:results] << Terms.copy(goal.value.data[:template]); return false
        end
        return true
      end
      goal = Terms.deref(goal)
      key = Terms.indicator(goal)
      args = goal.is_a?(Compound) ? goal.args : []
      if key == [',', 2]
        @goals = push(args.map { |g| entry(g, c, k) }, continuation)
      elsif key == ['!', 0]
        cut(c)
      elsif key == [';', 2]
        height = @choices.length
        point(:alt, push([entry(args[1], c, k)], continuation))
        if shape?(args[0], '->', 2)
          i, t = args[0].args
          @goals = push([entry(i, height + 1, k), entry(Marker.new(:ite, height), c, k), entry(t, c, k)], continuation)
        else
          @goals = push([entry(args[0], c, k)], continuation)
        end
      elsif key == ['->', 2]
        height = @choices.length
        @goals = push([entry(args[0], height, k), entry(Marker.new(:ite, height), c, k), entry(args[1], c, k)], continuation)
      elsif key == ['\\+', 1]
        height = @choices.length
        point(:alt, continuation)
        @goals = push([entry(Terms.compound('call', args[0]), c, k), entry(Marker.new(:naf, height), c, k)], continuation)
      elsif key[0] == 'call' && (1..8).cover?(key[1])
        target = Terms.deref(args[0])
        Terms.raise_error('instantiation_error') if target.is_a?(Variable)
        Terms.raise_error('type_error', 'callable', target) if target.is_a?(Integer)
        if args.length > 1
          target = target.is_a?(String) ? Compound.new(target, args.drop(1)) : Compound.new(target.name, target.args + args.drop(1))
        end
        converted = convert(target)
        Terms.raise_error('type_error', 'callable', target) unless converted
        @goals = push([entry(converted, @choices.length, k)], continuation)
      elsif key == ['catch', 3]
        cp = point(:catch, continuation, catcher: args[1], recovery: args[2], parent: k)
        @goals = push([entry(Terms.compound('call', args[0]), c, cp), entry(Marker.new(:exit, cp), c, k)], continuation)
      else
        inference(key)
        case key
        when ['findall', 3]
          cp = point(:findall, continuation, template: args[0], result: args[2], results: [])
          @goals = push([entry(Terms.compound('call', args[1]), c, k), entry(Marker.new(:collect, cp), c, k)], nil)
        when ['throw', 1]
          ball = Terms.deref(args[0])
          Terms.raise_error('instantiation_error') if ball.is_a?(Variable)
          raise RaisedBall.new(ball)
        when ['between', 3] then return between(args, continuation, k)
        when ['length', 2] then return length(args, continuation, k)
        else
          return @predicates.execute(goal) if Predicates::SIGNATURES.include?(key)
          return user_call(goal, c, k, continuation)
        end
      end
      true
    rescue LogicError => error
      raise RaisedBall.new(Terms.compound('error', error.term, Terms.pi(*key)))
    end
    def backtrack
      loop do
        @counters[:backtracks] += 1
        loop do
          return false if @choices.empty?
          cp = @choices.last
          @unifier.undo(cp.trail)
          if cp.kind == :catch
            @choices.pop
            next
          end
          break
        end
        cp, data = @choices.last, @choices.last.data
        case cp.kind
        when :alt
          @choices.pop
          @goals = cp.resume
          return true
        when :clauses
          index = data[:next]
          index == data[:candidates].length - 1 ? @choices.pop : data[:next] += 1
          return true if try_clause(data[:candidates][index], data[:goal], data[:barrier], data[:context], cp.resume)
        when :between
          inference(['between', 3])
          value = data[:next]
          value == data[:high] ? @choices.pop : data[:next] += 1
          if @unifier.unify(data[:variable], value)
            @goals = cp.resume
            return true
          end
        when :length
          inference(['length', 2])
          size = data[:next]
          data[:next] += 1
          if @unifier.unify(data[:tail], Terms.list(Array.new(size - data[:count]) { Variable.new })) && @unifier.unify(data[:variable], size)
            @goals = cp.resume
            return true
          end
        when :findall
          @choices.pop
          if @unifier.unify(Terms.list(data[:results]), data[:result])
            @goals = cp.resume
            return true
          end
        end
      end
    end
    def handle_exception(ball, context)
      while context
        index = @choices.index { |cp| cp.equal?(context) }
        cut(index)
        @unifier.undo(context.trail)
        height = @unifier.trail.length
        if @unifier.unify(Terms.copy(ball), context.data[:catcher])
          @goals = push([entry(Terms.compound('call', context.data[:recovery]), @choices.length, context.data[:parent])], context.resume)
          return true
        end
        @unifier.undo(height)
        context = context.data[:parent]
      end
      @answer_lines << "uncaught exception: #{write_term(ball)}"
      false
    end
    def answer(variables)
      seed = {}
      variables.each do |name, variable|
        value = Terms.deref(variable)
        seed[value] ||= name if value.is_a?(Variable)
      end
      names, previous, items = writer_names(seed), {}, []
      variables.each do |name, variable|
        value = Terms.deref(variable)
        if value.is_a?(Variable)
          items << "#{previous[value]} = #{name}" if previous.key?(value)
          previous[value] = name
        else
          items << "#{name} = #{write_term(value, true, 699, true, names)}"
        end
      end
      items.empty? ? 'true' : items.join(', ')
    end
    def query(term, variables, limit)
      @unifier, @choices, @query_output, @answer_lines = Unifier.new, [], +'', []
      @counters = { solutions: 0, inferences: 0, choicepoints: 0, backtracks: 0 }
      @predicates = Predicates.new(@unifier, @query_output, ->(t, q) { write_term(t, q) })
      @goals = push([entry(Terms.compound('call', term), 0, nil)], nil)
      loop do
        begin
          if @goals.nil?
            @counters[:solutions] += 1
            done = @counters[:solutions] == limit || @choices.empty?
            @answer_lines << answer(variables) + (done ? '.' : ' ;')
            break if done
            unless backtrack
              @answer_lines << 'false.'
              break
            end
          else
            current, continuation = @goals
            begin
              success = execute(current, continuation)
            rescue RaisedBall => error
              break unless handle_exception(error.ball, current.context)
              next
            end
            unless success || backtrack
              @answer_lines << 'false.'
              break
            end
          end
        rescue InferenceLimit
          @answer_lines << 'inference limit exceeded'
          break
        end
      end
      [@answer_lines, @query_output, @counters]
    end
    def counters_text(counts) = counts.map { |name, n| "#{name}=#{n}" }.join(' ')
    def run
      %w[prelude.pl program.pl].each { |file| consult(file) }
      undefined_warnings
      %w[prelude.pl program.pl].each do |file|
        @reports << "#{file}: #{counters_text(@file_counts[file])}"
      end
      @reports << "database: predicates=#{@database.predicates.length} clauses=#{@database.predicates.values.sum(&:length)}"
      answers, writes, stats = [], +'', []
      totals = { solutions: 0, inferences: 0, choicepoints: 0, backtracks: 0 }
      File.readlines('input/queries.txt', chomp: true).each_with_index do |line, i|
        number = i + 1
        answers << line
        writes << "== query #{number} ==\n"
        prefix = /\A(?:(\d+) )?\?- /.match(line)
        reader = Reader.new(line[prefix.end(0)..], prefix.end(0) + 1)
        begin
          term = reader.clause(query: true)
        rescue ReadError => e
          answers << "syntax error at column #{e.token.column}: #{e.message}"
          stats << "query #{number}: syntax error"
          next
        end
        variables = reader.variables.reject { |name, _| name.start_with?('_') }
        lines, output, counts = query(term, variables, prefix[1]&.to_i)
        answers.concat(lines)
        writes << output
        writes << "\n" unless output.empty? || output.end_with?("\n")
        stats << "query #{number}: #{counters_text(counts)}"
        counts.each { |key, count| totals[key] += count }
      end
      stats << "total: #{counters_text(totals)}"
      stats << '== profile =='
      @calls.keys.sort_by { |key| [-@calls[key], indicator_text(key)] }.each do |key|
        text = "#{indicator_text(key)} calls=#{@calls[key]}"
        text += " tries=#{@tries[key]}" if @database.predicates.key?(key)
        stats << text
      end
      File.write('output/consult.txt', @reports.join("\n") + "\n")
      File.write('output/listing.txt', listing)
      File.write('output/answers.txt', answers.empty? ? '' : answers.join("\n") + "\n")
      File.write('output/write_output.txt', writes)
      File.write('output/stats.txt', stats.join("\n") + "\n")
    end
  end
end

Prolog::Interpreter.new.run if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__

require_relative 'unify'

module Prolog
  class Predicates
    SIGNATURES = {
      0 => %w[true fail false nl],
      1 => %w[var nonvar atom number integer atomic compound callable is_list write writeq],
      2 => %w[= \= == \== is =:= =\= < > =< >= =.. copy_term atom_length atom_chars length],
      3 => %w[functor arg between findall],
    }.flat_map { |arity, names| names.map { |name| [name, arity] } }.push(['throw', 1]).freeze
    def initialize(unifier, output, writer)
      @unifier, @output, @writer = unifier, output, writer
    end
    def unify(a, b) = @unifier.unify(a, b)
    def error(name, *args) = Terms.raise_error(name, *args)
    def integer(term)
      term = Terms.deref(term)
      error('instantiation_error') if term.is_a?(Variable)
      error('type_error', 'integer', term) unless term.is_a?(Integer)
      term
    end
    def atom(term)
      term = Terms.deref(term)
      error('instantiation_error') if term.is_a?(Variable)
      error('type_error', 'atom', term) unless term.is_a?(String)
      term
    end
    def proper_list(term)
      elements, tail = Terms.elements(term)
      error('instantiation_error') if tail.is_a?(Variable)
      error('type_error', 'list', term) unless tail == '[]'
      elements
    end
    def evaluate(term)
      term = Terms.deref(term)
      return term if term.is_a?(Integer)
      error('instantiation_error') if term.is_a?(Variable)
      name, arity = Terms.indicator(term)
      valid = arity == 1 && %w[- abs].include?(name) || arity == 2 && %w[+ - * // mod rem min max].include?(name)
      error('type_error', 'evaluable', Terms.pi(name, arity)) unless valid
      args = term.args.map { |a| evaluate(a) }
      x, y = args
      error('evaluation_error', 'zero_divisor') if %w[// mod rem].include?(name) && y.zero?
      result = case name
               when '+' then x + y
               when '-' then arity == 1 ? -x : x - y
               when '*' then x * y
               when '//' then x.abs.div(y.abs) * (x.negative? == y.negative? ? 1 : -1)
               when 'mod' then x - y * x.div(y)
               when 'rem' then x - y * (x.abs.div(y.abs) * (x.negative? == y.negative? ? 1 : -1))
               when 'abs' then x.abs
               when 'min' then [x, y].min
               when 'max' then [x, y].max
               end
      error('evaluation_error', 'int_overflow') unless (-2147483648..2147483647).cover?(result)
      result
    end
    def execute(goal)
      name, = Terms.indicator(goal)
      args = goal.is_a?(Compound) ? goal.args : []
      x, y, z = args.map { |a| Terms.deref(a) }
      case name
      when 'true' then true
      when 'fail', 'false' then false
      when '=' then unify(x, y)
      when '\\='
        height = @unifier.trail.length
        result = unify(x, y)
        @unifier.undo(height)
        !result
      when '==' then @unifier.identical?(x, y)
      when '\\==' then !@unifier.identical?(x, y)
      when 'var' then x.is_a?(Variable)
      when 'nonvar' then !x.is_a?(Variable)
      when 'atom' then x.is_a?(String)
      when 'number', 'integer' then x.is_a?(Integer)
      when 'atomic' then x.is_a?(String) || x.is_a?(Integer)
      when 'compound' then x.is_a?(Compound)
      when 'callable' then Terms.callable?(x)
      when 'is_list' then Terms.elements(x).last == '[]'
      when 'is' then unify(x, evaluate(y))
      when '=:=', '=\\=', '<', '>', '=<', '>='
        a, b = evaluate(x), evaluate(y)
        case name
        when '=:=' then a == b
        when '=\\=' then a != b
        when '<' then a < b
        when '>' then a > b
        when '=<' then a <= b
        when '>=' then a >= b
        end
      when 'functor'
        if !x.is_a?(Variable)
          n, a = x.is_a?(Compound) ? [x.name, x.args.length] : [x, 0]
          unify(y, n) && unify(z, a)
        else
          error('instantiation_error') if y.is_a?(Variable) || z.is_a?(Variable)
          error('type_error', 'atomic', y) if y.is_a?(Compound)
          error('type_error', 'integer', z) unless z.is_a?(Integer)
          error('domain_error', 'not_less_than_zero', z) if z.negative?
          error('representation_error', 'max_arity') if z > 255
          return unify(x, y) if z.zero?
          error('type_error', 'atom', y) if y.is_a?(Integer)
          unify(x, Compound.new(y, Array.new(z) { Variable.new }))
        end
      when 'arg'
        error('instantiation_error') if x.is_a?(Variable) || y.is_a?(Variable)
        error('type_error', 'integer', x) unless x.is_a?(Integer)
        error('type_error', 'compound', y) unless y.is_a?(Compound)
        (1..y.args.length).cover?(x) && unify(y.args[x - 1], z)
      when '=..'
        if !x.is_a?(Variable)
          unify(Terms.list(x.is_a?(Compound) ? [x.name, *x.args] : [x]), y)
        else
          elements = proper_list(y)
          error('domain_error', 'non_empty_list', '[]') if elements.empty?
          head = Terms.deref(elements.first)
          error('instantiation_error') if head.is_a?(Variable)
          if elements.length == 1
            error('type_error', 'atomic', head) if head.is_a?(Compound)
            unify(x, head)
          else
            error('type_error', 'atom', head) unless head.is_a?(String)
            error('representation_error', 'max_arity') if elements.length > 256
            unify(x, Compound.new(head, elements.drop(1)))
          end
        end
      when 'copy_term' then unify(Terms.copy(x), y)
      when 'atom_length'
        value = atom(x)
        error('type_error', 'integer', y) unless y.is_a?(Variable) || y.is_a?(Integer)
        unify(value.length, y)
      when 'atom_chars'
        if !x.is_a?(Variable)
          unify(y, Terms.list(atom(x).chars))
        else
          chars = proper_list(y).map do |element|
            element = Terms.deref(element)
            error('instantiation_error') if element.is_a?(Variable)
            error('type_error', 'character', element) unless element.is_a?(String) && element.length == 1
            element
          end
          unify(x, chars.join)
        end
      when 'write', 'writeq'
        @output << @writer.call(x, name == 'writeq')
        true
      when 'nl'
        @output << "\n"
        true
      end
    end
  end
end

require_relative 'terms'

module Prolog
  SYMBOLS = '+-*/\\^<>=~:.?@#&$'.freeze
  INFIX = { ':-' => [1200, :xfx], ';' => [1100, :xfy], '->' => [1050, :xfy], ',' => [1000, :xfy] }
  %w[= \= == \== is =:= =\= < > =< >= =..].each { |s| INFIX[s] = [700, :xfx] }
  %w[+ -].each { |s| INFIX[s] = [500, :yfx] }
  %w[* / // mod rem].each { |s| INFIX[s] = [400, :yfx] }
  INFIX.freeze
  PREFIX = { '\\+' => 900, '-' => 200 }.freeze
  Token = Struct.new(:kind, :value, :spelling, :line, :column, :space, keyword_init: true)
  class ReadError < StandardError
    attr_reader :token, :index
    def initialize(token, index, message)
      @token, @index = token, index
      super(message)
    end
  end
  class Reader
    attr_reader :tokens, :index, :variables, :occurrences
    def initialize(text, start_column = 1)
      @tokens, @index = [], 0
      lex(text, start_column)
    end
    def lex(text, column)
      i, line, whitespace = 0, 1, true
      while i < text.length
        c = text[i]
        if c == ' ' || c == "\n"
          if c == "\n"
            line += 1
            column = 1
          else
            column += 1
          end
          i += 1
          whitespace = true
          next
        elsif c == '%'
          while i < text.length && text[i] != "\n"
            i += 1
            column += 1
          end
          whitespace = true
          next
        end
        start, col, kind, value = i, column, nil, nil
        if c.match?(/[0-9]/)
          i += 1 while i < text.length && text[i].match?(/[0-9]/)
          value = text[start...i].to_i
          kind = value > 2147483647 ? :invalid : :int
          value = 'integer too large' if kind == :invalid
        elsif c.match?(/[A-Za-z_]/)
          i += 1 while i < text.length && text[i].match?(/[A-Za-z0-9_]/)
          kind = c.match?(/[a-z]/) ? :name : :var
          value = text[start...i]
        elsif SYMBOLS.include?(c)
          i += 1 while i < text.length && SYMBOLS.include?(text[i])
          value = text[start...i]
          kind = value == '.' && (i == text.length || [" ", "\n", '%'].include?(text[i])) ? :end : :name
        elsif c == '!' || c == ';'
          kind, value = :name, c
          i += 1
        elsif ',|()[]'.include?(c)
          kind, value = :punct, c
          i += 1
        elsif c == "'"
          i += 1
          value, incorrect, closed = +'', false, false
          while i < text.length && text[i] != "\n"
            if text[i] == "'"
              if text[i + 1] == "'"
                value << "'"
                i += 2
              else
                i += 1
                closed = true
                break
              end
            elsif text[i] == '\\'
              if i + 1 == text.length || text[i + 1] == "\n"
                i += 1
              else
                escapes = { 'n' => "\n", 't' => "\t", '\\' => '\\', "'" => "'" }
                v = escapes[text[i + 1]]
                if v
                  value << v
                else
                  incorrect = true
                end
                i += 2
              end
            else
              value << text[i]
              i += 1
            end
          end
          kind = closed && !incorrect ? :quoted : :invalid
          value = closed ? 'undefined escape sequence' : 'unterminated quoted atom' if kind == :invalid
        else
          kind, value = :invalid, "illegal character '#{c}'"
          i += 1
        end
        tokens << Token.new(kind: kind, value: value, spelling: text[start...i], line: line, column: col, space: whitespace)
        column += i - start
        whitespace = false
      end
      tokens << Token.new(kind: :eof, value: nil, spelling: '', line: line, column: column, space: whitespace)
    end
    def peek = tokens[index]
    def take
      token = peek
      @index += 1 unless token.kind == :eof
      token
    end
    def fail_at(token, message = nil)
      message ||= case token.kind
                  when :invalid then token.value
                  when :eof then 'unexpected end of file'
                  when :end then 'unexpected end of clause'
                  else token.kind == :name && INFIX.key?(token.value) ? 'operator priority clash' : "unexpected \"#{token.spelling}\""
                  end
      raise ReadError.new(token, tokens.index { |t| t.equal?(token) }, message)
    end
    def expect(value)
      token = take
      fail_at(token) unless token.kind == :punct && token.value == value
    end
    def clause(query: false)
      @variables, @occurrences = {}, Hash.new(0)
      term, = read_term(1200)
      last = take
      fail_at(last) unless last.kind == :end
      fail_at(peek) if query && peek.kind != :eof
      term
    end
    def recover(error)
      @index = error.index
      @index += 1 while peek.kind != :end && peek.kind != :eof
      take if peek.kind == :end
    end
    def infix_token?(token) = (token.kind == :name || token.kind == :punct && token.value == ',') && INFIX.key?(token.value)
    def can_start?(token)
      return true if %i[int var quoted].include?(token.kind)
      return true if token.kind == :punct && ['(', '['].include?(token.value)
      token.kind == :name && (!INFIX.key?(token.value) || PREFIX.key?(token.value))
    end
    def read_term(limit)
      term, priority = primary(limit)
      while infix_token?(peek)
        p, type = INFIX[peek.value]
        left = type == :yfx ? p : p - 1
        break unless p <= limit && priority <= left
        op = take.value
        right, = read_term(type == :xfy ? p : p - 1)
        term, priority = Terms.compound(op, term, right), p
      end
      [term, priority]
    end
    def primary(limit)
      token = take
      case token.kind
      when :int then [token.value, 0]
      when :var
        name = token.value
        occurrences[name] += 1
        variable = name == '_' ? Variable.new : (variables[name] ||= Variable.new)
        [variable, 0]
      when :punct
        if token.value == '('
          term, = read_term(1200)
          expect(')')
          [term, 0]
        elsif token.value == '['
          if peek.kind == :punct && peek.value == ']'
            take
            return ['[]', 0]
          end
          elements = [read_term(999).first]
          while peek.kind == :punct && peek.value == ','
            take
            elements << read_term(999).first
          end
          tail = '[]'
          if peek.kind == :punct && peek.value == '|'
            take
            tail = read_term(999).first
          end
          expect(']')
          [Terms.list(elements, tail), 0]
        else
          fail_at(token)
        end
      when :name, :quoted
        name = token.value
        if peek.kind == :punct && peek.value == '(' && !peek.space
          take
          args = [read_term(999).first]
          while peek.kind == :punct && peek.value == ','
            take
            args << read_term(999).first
          end
          expect(')')
          [Compound.new(name, args), 0]
        elsif token.kind == :name && name == '-' && peek.kind == :int && !peek.space
          [-take.value, 0]
        elsif token.kind == :name && PREFIX.key?(name) && can_start?(peek)
          p = PREFIX[name]
          fail_at(token, 'operator priority clash') if p > limit
          [Terms.compound(name, read_term(p).first), p]
        else
          [name, 0]
        end
      else
        fail_at(token)
      end
    end
  end
end

module Prolog
  class Variable
    attr_accessor :binding
  end
  Compound = Struct.new(:name, :args)
  class LogicError < StandardError
    attr_reader :term
    def initialize(term)
      @term = term
      super('Prolog error')
    end
  end
  module Terms
    def self.deref(term)
      term = term.binding while term.is_a?(Variable) && term.binding
      term
    end
    def self.compound(name, *args) = Compound.new(name, args)
    def self.callable?(term) = term.is_a?(String) || term.is_a?(Compound)
    def self.indicator(term)
      term = deref(term)
      term.is_a?(String) ? [term, 0] : [term.name, term.args.length]
    end
    def self.pi(name, arity) = compound('/', name, arity)
    def self.list(elements, tail = '[]') = elements.reverse_each.reduce(tail) { |rest, element| compound('.', element, rest) }
    def self.elements(term)
      values = []
      term = deref(term)
      while term.is_a?(Compound) && term.name == '.' && term.args.length == 2
        values << term.args[0]
        term = deref(term.args[1])
      end
      [values, term]
    end
    def self.copy(term, variables = {})
      term = deref(term)
      case term
      when Variable then variables[term] ||= Variable.new
      when Compound then Compound.new(term.name, term.args.map { |a| copy(a, variables) })
      else term
      end
    end
    def self.variables(term, result = [])
      term = deref(term)
      if term.is_a?(Variable)
        result << term
      elsif term.is_a?(Compound)
        term.args.each { |a| variables(a, result) }
      end
      result
    end
    def self.error(name, *args) = args.empty? ? name : compound(name, *args)
    def self.raise_error(name, *args) = raise LogicError.new(error(name, *args))
  end
end

require_relative 'terms'

module Prolog
  class Unifier
    attr_reader :trail
    def initialize = @trail = []
    def undo(height)
      trail.pop.binding = nil while trail.length > height
    end
    def unify(a, b)
      pending = [[a, b]]
      until pending.empty?
        x, y = pending.pop.map { |t| Terms.deref(t) }
        next if x.equal?(y)
        if x.is_a?(Variable)
          x.binding = y
          trail << x
        elsif y.is_a?(Variable)
          y.binding = x
          trail << y
        elsif x.is_a?(Compound) && y.is_a?(Compound) && x.name == y.name && x.args.length == y.args.length
          (x.args.length - 1).downto(0) { |i| pending << [x.args[i], y.args[i]] }
        elsif x.class != y.class || x != y
          return false
        end
      end
      true
    end
    def identical?(a, b)
      pending = [[a, b]]
      until pending.empty?
        x, y = pending.pop.map { |t| Terms.deref(t) }
        next if x.equal?(y)
        return false if x.is_a?(Variable) || y.is_a?(Variable)
        if x.is_a?(Compound) && y.is_a?(Compound) && x.name == y.name && x.args.length == y.args.length
          (x.args.length - 1).downto(0) { |i| pending << [x.args[i], y.args[i]] }
        elsif x.class != y.class || x != y
          return false
        end
      end
      true
    end
  end
end
